name: URL Encode / Decode
summary: Percent-encode or decode URLs and query parameters right in your browser.
description: Escape special characters for use in URLs, or decode percent-encoded strings back to readable text. Switch between component encoding (for query values) and full-URL encoding.

faqs.question: What is component mode?
faqs.answer: Component mode encodes reserved characters like / ? & = so a value can be safely dropped into a query string. Full-URL mode preserves those delimiters.

faqs.question: Is my input sent to a server?
faqs.answer: No. Encoding uses your browser's built-in encodeURIComponent and decodeURIComponent.

faqs.question: Why did decoding fail?
faqs.answer: Malformed percent-encodings (like a stray %) cannot be decoded. Fix or remove them and try again.
